name: CBC News
description:

We started our YouTube journey in 2020 and we haven’t looked back. We travel the world as full time travel Vloggers and document our experiences right HERE! 

Our YouTube channel was a total accident as we originally planned to move to Canada, but in 2020 when the world changed we were forced to make new plans. description:
Hey there! 👋 We’re Giselle & Stephen!

We help you spend less time planning and more time exploring with detailed travel guides, realistic itineraries, hotel reviews, road-trip routes, hiking tips, cruise guides, and everything you need to plan an unforgettable adventure.

Our journey started in April 2020 when we bought our first camera and taught ourselves photography while road-tripping and car camping around the western United States. description: Welcome to my channel A Walk on the Wild Side. I am an award winning professional photographer specialising in travel, weather & astronomy.
